scope: Test-only source-input CPU paint; two captured native-generated quads, not generalized Stroke-to-quad generation, production, SVG/PDF or device parity.

source.geometry_location: crates/sdocx/src/ink/smudge.rs constants; native float bits and upload hashes checked in Rust
source.generated_input: Deterministic per-channel x/y high-frequency RGBA8 formula in Rust, opaque alpha; separate all-zero transparent control.

oracle_role: Per-draw full-frame hashes are expected outputs only. No captured framebuffer or scratch pixels are renderer inputs.
proof: Native full Model Construct, lower Drawing helper, native queued renderer and same-bitmap API/Mesa readback joins. Link-time shader bytes independently match native DSO strings.
limits: P4 final mix narrows to half; P5 output remains F32. Samplers use fixed-fraction integer interpolation and F16RTZ.
CVTPS2DQ nearest-even assumes unrecorded MXCSR; dither is enabled but has no observed pixel effect in these controls.
First paint quad is outside the viewport; model executes that draw and rejects unexpected coverage. The final paint draw has nonempty coverage.
Context identity in shader snapshots is adapter-instance scoped, not a proof of arbitrary EGL context reuse.
Synthetic host inputs, queue and libc/libm services remain explicit boundaries.

translated_interior_control.scope: Host ObjectStroke source points translated before native Model construction; native-generated quads and readbacks observed. First paint pass changes four destination pixels and later feedback samples that destination.

interpolation_source.scope: Float32 triangle-plane setup and captured fragment-IR FMA order. Vertex order after clipping and fixed-point edge coverage remain unverified beyond these controls.
